title: A Generalizable Approach to Safety-Aware Robotic Behavior Planning with an Explicit Constraint Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.18026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language and vision-language models have substantially advanced robotic behavior planning from natural-language instructions and visual observations. However, safe manipulation in tabletop environments remains challenging because the safety constraints required for a task depend on the surrounding scene and may not be explicitly specified in the instruction. We propose a safety-aware behavior planning framework based on an explicit Constraint Space that stores reusable textual safety rules. Rather than retrieving rules solely by semantic similarity, we formulate constraint selection as task- and environment-conditioned applicability learning. A lightweight query-conditioned dual-tower model identifies the constraints applicable to the current context, which are then provided together with the original task and image to a multimodal behavior planner. translated_title: 一种基于显式约束空间的可泛化安全感知机器人行为规划方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型和视觉-语言模型已经极大地推动了基于自然语言指令和视觉观测的机器人行为规划。然而，在桌面环境中的安全操作仍然具有挑战性，因为任务所需的安全约束取决于周围场景，并且可能未在指令中被明确指定。我们提出了一种基于显式约束空间的安全感知行为规划框架，该约束空间存储可复用的文本形式安全规则。我们不再仅通过语义相似度来检索规则，而是将约束选择形式化为以任务和环境为条件的适用性学习。一个轻量级的、以查询为条件的双塔模型识别出适用于当前上下文的约束，随后将这些约束连同原始任务和图像一起提供给多模态行为规划器。为了处理错误的约束选择以及先前未见过的危险，我们引入……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于显式约束空间的安全感知机器人行为规划框架，通过任务与环境条件的适用性学习（结合轻量级双塔模型）来选择适用的安全规则并交给多模态规划器，从而提升桌面环境中机器人操作的安全性与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a safety-aware robotic behavior planning framework built on an explicit Constraint Space, which selects applicable safety rules through task- and environment-conditioned applicability learning with a lightweight dual-tower model, enabling generalizable safe manipulation in tabletop environments.
